note: Which evidence file backs which cell of the acceptance table. Kept in the repository because the mapping used to live only in ad-hoc shell scripts on the collecting machine, which made the headline table readable but not re-runnable. Paths are relative to 'root' unless absolute. CHAIR and TextVQA point at corrected collections (2026-10-13) -- see 'corrections' below; running summary_table.py against this manifest therefore reproduces the corrected table, not the one reported earlier.

CHAIR.why: the cross-model channel had been grown by appending and de-duplicated on the answer string alone, so the three cells did not carry the same number of donor readings (3, 3 and 2) and no field recorded which model any reading came from
CHAIR.what: rebuilt with exactly the other two models' current primary answers per cell, each tagged provider/provider_file/provider_sha256 in its meta

TextVQA.why: the in-repo label function used this project's own normalise_text; the scoring shape matched the official evaluator but the normalisation did not, so the labels were not the official ones
TextVQA.what: relabelled with the official VQA normalisation; every row also carries official_vqa_score and label_original_rule so both readings can be compared
